name: Draft and review until approved
description: A writer drafts and a reviewer reviews, again and again, until the reviewer replies APPROVED or three rounds have run; an editor then formats the result.

steps.instructions: Write a short project summary from the input. If the input is review feedback, revise the summary to address it.
Review the summary. If it is clear and accurate, reply APPROVED on the first line followed by the summary unchanged; otherwise list what to fix.
Format the approved summary as Markdown.
